title: tmp+rename write order for queue files is correct and well-documented
description: Both NntpQueue and SmtpRelayQueue write .msg first (tmp+rename), then .env (tmp+rename). The comment in relay_queue.rs lines 113-122 explains the crash-safety contract: if .env is absent, the drain skips the entry; if .msg is absent, something went wrong. This is the correct order — writing the 'pointer' (.env, which the drain scans for) last means the drain never sees a partial entry. A contributor might suggest simplifying to a single atomic write or reversing the order. Do not accept either change.
